edges.reason: The Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the owner state variable.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable in transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the staged owner into newOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender equalling owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner.
The newOwner state variable is read to authorize and complete the ownership transfer.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
The Xenith constructor sets the symbol state variable.
The Xenith constructor sets the name state variable.
The Xenith constructor sets the decimals state variable.
The Xenith constructor initializes the total supply.
The Xenith constructor mints the entire supply into the balances mapping.
transfer debits the caller balance keyed by msg.sender.
The to parameter is the credit target of transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved in transfer.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer delegates its subtraction to safeSub.
transfer delegates its addition to safeAdd.
approve keys the allowance mapping by msg.sender.
The spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
The tokens parameter is written as the allowance value in approve.
approve writes into the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom resolves the caller allowance through msg.sender without a direct owner check.
The from parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credit target in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for both accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the caller.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance subtraction to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates balance addition to safeAdd.
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowance lookup.
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowance lookup.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burn adjustment.
approveAndCall keys the allowance mapping by msg.sender.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target.
The tokens parameter is granted as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
The data parameter is attacker-influenced calldata forwarded to the external call.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
The user-supplied spender determines the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall performs an external callback to an arbitrary spender contract, enabling reentrancy into allowance/token state.
The tokens amount is passed into the external receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
The tokenAddress parameter controls the target of the arbitrary external ERC20 call.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call to a caller-supplied contract address.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the owner state variable as the transfer recipient.
First operand a flows into safeAdd.
Second operand b flows into safeAdd.
safeAdd assigns the checked sum to its return variable c.
First operand a flows into safeSub.
Second operand b flows into safeSub.
safeSub assigns the checked difference to its return variable c.
First operand a flows into safeMul.
Second operand b flows into safeMul.
safeMul assigns the checked product to its return variable c.
Numerator a flows into safeDiv.
Denominator b flows into safeDiv.
safeDiv assigns the checked quotient to its return variable c.
The fallback function ignores msg.sender and unconditionally reverts.
